# Field notes

A small documentation site for a useful project. Built to be clear, calm, and easy to navigate.

## Getting started

Keep your documentation with your code. This site uses a single README, rendered into a considered layout with a clear hierarchy.

1. Add your configuration.
2. Choose the details that matter.
   - Set the repository description.
   - Add your project icon.
     - Use a square image.
     - Keep its edges simple.
3. Publish your documentation.

Visit the [project repository](https://github.com/sample-owner/project), read the [license](LICENSE.md), or jump to [configuration](#configuration).

## Configuration

Readable defaults leave room for the content. Settings can be adjusted to suit the project.

| Setting | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Content width | 960px | Comfortable reading |
| Cards | Three | Clear separation |
| Color scheme | Light | Calm, legible surfaces |
| Typography | System fonts | Fast and familiar |

### Project defaults

```yaml
remote_theme: aonanj/aonanj-style@main
repository: sample-owner/project
baseurl: /project
```

> Good documentation gives readers a clear starting point and a useful next step.
